recommendation: Reject in the present form; not review-ready as a completed R25 submission

moving_transport_audit.interpretation: The executed moving control is a capped linearized historical-Jacobian transport with potentially material carrier/economic-coordinate drift; it does not cleanly identify an irreducible neural mechanism.

headline_findings: The reviewed head is an integration protocol rather than a completed R25 manuscript; ECTA_R25.tex, SUPP_R25.tex and RESPONSE_R25.tex are absent and REVISION_INDEX.md still points to R23.

The original current-state full-domain fine bound is 7.181834580823298 against the unchanged 0.01 target, approximately 718 times the target; the fine-bound improvement over the untouched warm start is only about 0.258 percent.
Direct L-BFGS-B remains the strongest tested held-out accuracy/work method, with slightly lower worst certified regret and far fewer gradient calls than neural Adam.

The moving historical-transport control is frequently trust-capped and develops carrier/economic-coordinate mismatch as large as about 0.719, so it is not yet a faithful mechanism-isolation control for neural parameterization.
The manufactured stochastic benchmark uses the known witness in training and primarily validates the global verifier rather than neural discovery of an unknown Bellman solution.
The directed stopped-payoff secants do not establish a rigorous stopped-gradient error bound; three of four adjacent secant intervals contain zero.
All 24 prospective online blocks are accepted, so the main experiment does not exercise actual rejection, optimizer-state restoration, or rate-halving after a harmful proposal.
